### Concept
Projectile on inclined plane

### Solution
Range R = 88.7 m, Height H = 38.4 m, Time T = 5.54 s

### Steps
u = 32 m/s, θ = 60°
R = u²sin2θ/g = 88.7 m
H = u²sin²θ/2g = 38.4 m
T = 2usinθ/g = 5.54 s
